# Support

This repository is published for reference and comes without support. Questions,
bug reports and feature requests about this source code are not answered, and
pull requests may not be reviewed or merged.

Support for the Pulsar XBOARD QS keyboard, with the firmware shipped on it or
published on the official support page, is available from
[Pulsar](https://www.pulsar.gg/).

See the [Notice](../README.md#notice) in the README for the warranty and
liability terms.
